framing.lineOfInquiry: Neha Gupta (P00010) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE037
framing.alternate: Neha Gupta (P00010) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: Was near the scene for a routine reason
alternateHypotheses.statement: Neha Gupta was near the scene because they regularly go there (home, work, market), not because of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: Recorded within 1 km of the scene on 28 other days (28 Apr – 27 Jun), so presence there is part of their routine

alternateHypotheses.test: Establish why the person is regularly there (address, employment, shop) and compare the incident-time visit with their usual pattern (time of day, duration).

alternateHypotheses.title: The contact was routine, not coordination
alternateHypotheses.statement: Neha Gupta's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: In contact with Sandeep Singh since 2025-05-02, 25 days before the incident (5 calls, 4 messages) — a long-standing relationship
In contact with Mukesh Jain since 2025-05-03, 24 days before the incident (2 calls, 6 messages) — a long-standing relationship
Contact around the incident (31) is close to the normal baseline (≈25.6), with no unusual spike

alternateHypotheses.test: Examine message content and the timing of contact relative to the incident; establish the relationship.

alternateHypotheses.title: Mistaken identity
alternateHypotheses.statement: Records belonging to someone else (a namesake or a wrongly matched profile) were attributed to Neha Gupta.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: 1 other person record(s) share the name 'Neha Gupta' (P00009), so name-based records can be misattributed

alternateHypotheses.test: Confirm identity with photograph or fingerprints (NAFIS), father's name and address from the FIR particulars.

alternateHypotheses.title: The money has a legitimate explanation
alternateHypotheses.statement: The flagged money movements of Neha Gupta have an ordinary purpose (salary, rent, property, business) or belong to a co-holder of the account.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak
